Inside Macintosh: Cyberdog Programmer's Kit / Part 3 - Cyberdog Reference
Chapter 7 - Classes and Methods / CyberContainerExtension

EnableOKButton

Enables or disables the OK button in this dialog box container. 
void EnableOKButton (in ODBoolean enabled);
enabled
kODTrue if the OK button should be enabled; kODFalse if the OK button should be disabled.
DISCUSSION
You call this method from an embedded panel to notify the dialog box to enable or disable its OK button.

If you subclass CyberContainerExtension, you must override this method. Your override must not call its inherited method; that is, your override method must implement this method's functionality completely.
